key_provisions_or_claims: Singapore has advanced AI strategy but gaps remain in public literacy, workforce readiness, and operational regulatory clarity.
AI threats across psychological, social, economic, military, civil and digital domains can affect national resilience.
Recommends adaptive AI governance and competency-based human resource development.
Recommends penta-helix collaboration toward the AI-Society 2030 vision.
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue record of a Lemhannas (Indonesian National Resilience Institute) study on raising Singapore society's mastery of AI to strengthen national resilience. It finds gaps in public literacy, workforce readiness, regulatory clarity and stakeholder synergy, and recommends adaptive AI governance, AI-competency workforce development, and penta-helix collaboration.
annotation.title_clean: Meningkatkan penguasaan teknologi AI (Artifical Intelligence) masyarakat Singapura untuk memperkuat ketahanan nasional
annotation.title_en: Improving Singapore Society's Mastery of AI Technology to Strengthen National Resilience
